title: Ledger Handbook - Customer-Pay Repairs: Balance, Payments, Refunds, Credits and Closing
content:
## The repair order balance

The balance of a Customer-Pay Repairs repair order is what the customer owes on it. Work, restocking, storage charges and refunds of overpayments post in; deposits, payments and credits (discounts, corrections, goodwill) post out. Over the life of the repair order the balance is the total of what posts in less the total of what posts out.

| Posts in (raises the balance) | Posts out (lowers the balance) |
|---|---|
| Charges: quoted work, additional work, restocking, non-returnable parts, work performed, storage | Credits against a named charge: discount, billing error, goodwill |
| Refunds, each naming the payment it returns | Payments: deposit, balance or fleet invoice, by card, ACH, cash, check or financing |

## Rules

1. Payments reduce the balance; a refund names the payment it returns and never exceeds it, going back to that payment's method within the tier's refund period in business days.
2. A payment may be refunded only once.
3. A billing error credit corrects a charge posted at a wrong amount.
4. Goodwill credits are limited to the tier's goodwill credit authority per repair order, counting all goodwill already credited on that repair order; a request beyond that is declined at the desk.
5. The repair order closes once delivered (or cancelled and the vehicle collected) with the repair order balance at zero.

## Condition on a refund

> A payment may be refunded only once.

The ledger decides it: a refund already recorded that names the same payment means that payment has been refunded.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

**Refunds.** A 500.00 card payment: a refund of 84.00 naming it goes back to the card; a refund of 600.00 naming it would exceed the payment and is not made; once the 84.00 refund is recorded, no second refund names that payment.

**Goodwill (a tier with a goodwill authority of 60.00, 40.00 already credited as goodwill on the order).**

| Request | Goodwill with the request | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 20.00 | 60.00 | within the authority |
| 25.00 | 65.00 | beyond the authority; declined at the desk |

**Balance and closing.** A delivered order with charges of 1569.95, a discount credit of 150.00 and payments of 1419.95 has a balance of zero and closes; with payments of 1400.00 the balance is 19.95 and the order stays open.
